purpose: Decision study of observe-only current-rule scoring, explicit immediate restart_from_best, and a two-consecutive-hit restart rule. The study tests mode-origin safety, nuisance-action reduction, retained efficacy, funnel behavior, no-fire identity, completeness, and efficiency.

evidence_basis.chain_rescue_v1: WP33 made restart_from_best the default after 25/27 gates versus 21/27 for no rescue, but documented that moving a second-mode chain can make R-hat blind.
evidence_basis.posteriordb_bench_v6: WP35 recorded 30 restarts in 21 cells: 21 log-density and 9 step events, including hmm_drive_0 on every seed and nuisance actions on kidiq, earnings, and diamonds.
evidence_basis.process_stability: The merged WP35 follow-up reproduced a four-replica STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION after a durable sampling result during the teardown span; a durable result followed by abnormal process exit is therefore a process fault.

seed_policy.interpretation: No seed appeared as a standalone integer token in tracked files outside artifact directories before this scaffold was created; occurrences embedded in longer integers, decimals, or exponents were excluded.

scoring.boundary: End of each completed slow metric window, after metric update and dual-averaging restart.

density.chain_score: median selected-state log density over the completed window
density.reference: across-chain median of chain window median log densities
density.spread: across-chain median of chain window log-density IQRs

scoring.eligibility: At least the current-rule minimum chains and transitions, all required scores finite, and at least one non-outlier source.
scoring.canonical_criterion: Step when step_hit is true, including when both booleans are true; otherwise LogDensity when density_hit is true; otherwise null.
scoring.source: Largest-step non-outlier chain; ties by larger median log density, then lower chain index.
scoring.source_position: Uniform source-window index drawn with the rescued chain's own RNG only when a restart is actually performed.

observe.behavior: Compute current-rule scores, booleans, canonical criterion, and deterministic proposed source; never mutate chain state.
observe.required_identity: Bit-identical to rescue disabled apart from added telemetry.

current.behavior: Explicit immediate ChainRescueConfig::restart_from_best; do not inherit the process default.
current.action: Restart on every eligible non-null canonical criterion using current source-window and state-transfer semantics.

two_hit.behavior: Restart only on the same chain and same non-null canonical criterion at two consecutive eligible slow-window boundaries.
two_hit.first_hit: Set prior criterion to the canonical criterion and streak to 1; do not mutate or consume rescue RNG.
two_hit.second_same_hit: Recompute the source, restart, then reset prior criterion and streak.
two_hit.criterion_change: Reset the old streak and start the new criterion at streak 1.
two_hit.restart: Reset criterion and streak to zero after the action.
two_hit.consecutive_definition: Adjacent slow-window boundaries in that chain's telemetry; a skipped boundary breaks the sequence.

telemetry.observe_constraint: Observe may record a deterministic source chain but must not select or simulate a source-window position.

initial_position_hash.encoding: domain separator bytes, dimension as little-endian u64, then each unconstrained coordinate's IEEE-754 f64::to_bits() as little-endian u64 in coordinate order
initial_position_hash.pairing_requirement: All four per-chain hashes must match across the three arms for a model/seed triplet.

definitions.a1_a2: Means of the subject chain in the two retained halves.
definitions.b1_b2: Means over the 1500 matching-half draws from the other three chains.
definitions.m: Type-7 median over all posteriordb reference draws.
definitions.I: Type-7 IQR over all posteriordb reference draws.

parameter_rule: For one common sign s in {-1,+1}, s*(a1-b1) >= 1.50*I and s*(a2-b2) >= 1.50*I.
stable_separated_origin.chain_rule: A chain is a stable separated origin when at least one scalar parameter satisfies the parameter rule.
stable_separated_origin.paired_mapping: Map by target, seed, chain index, and identical initial_position_sha256.
stable_separated_origin.origin_overwritten: Any current or two_hit restart of a mapped stable separated origin.
stable_separated_origin.rhat_credit: Raw post-action R-hat is reported, but an origin_overwritten cell has its credited diagnostic gate forced to fail and cannot count as a rescued convergence win.
stable_separated_origin.funnel_reference: Apply the same rule to omega using the analytic N(0,3) median and IQR.

posteriordb_diagnostic_gates.credit_override: origin_overwritten forces credited failure while preserving raw metrics.

raw_reporting: Every parameter z and practical shift.
Maximum absolute z and its parameter.
Maximum practical shift and its parameter.
reference_agreement.legacy_gate: No credited diagnostic-passing cell has raw maximum |z| > 4.0.
reference_agreement.decisive_disagreement: For the same parameter, |z| > 4.0 and practical_shift >= 0.10.
reference_agreement.decisive_scope: Every process-valid cell, including a diagnostic-failing cell.
reference_agreement.multiplicity: No global Holm adjustment. Only two named paired sign tests are inferential; all fixed gates are conjunctive and no universal model-family claim is made.

process_protocol.atomic_result: Write temporary raw result, flush, and atomically rename before teardown.
process_protocol.valid_cell: Child exits successfully and durable result is complete and schema-valid.
process_protocol.post_result_crash: A nonzero or abnormal process exit after a durable result is a process fault.
process_protocol.triplet_exclusion: Any timeout, abnormal exit, missing or malformed result, initial-position hash mismatch, or process-protocol failure invalidates the entire three-arm target/seed triplet for paired analysis.
process_protocol.sampler_error: A sampler-level error returned by a successful schema-valid child is a valid failing result.
process_protocol.reruns: No planned child is launched more than once, including after a process fault.

paired_inference.ties: Exact zero differences are omitted from the named sign test only.
paired_inference.failure_class_seed_score: Number from 0 to 3 of credited standard diagnostic passes over hmm_drive_0, arma11, and lotka_volterra.
paired_inference.nuisance_seed_score: Total restarted chains over kidiq, earnings, and diamonds.
paired_inference.efficiency: Minimum over reference parameters of min(bulk ESS, tail ESS) divided by total target calls including warmup and retention. A missing, nonfinite, or nonpositive value in a process-valid triplet fails the efficiency gate rather than creating a process exclusion.
paired_inference.wall_time: Reported, not gated on the shared machine.

completeness: Every target has at least 10 process-valid paired triplets.
Each named sign test has at least 10 complete and at least 10 non-tied seed blocks.
safety: two_hit has zero decisive reference disagreements.
The WP35 legacy reference gate holds for two_hit.
On each of kidiq, earnings, diamonds, and mesquite, two_hit credited pass count is no more than one below either paired observe or current.
For each comparator separately, sum max(0, comparator_passes - two_hit_passes) over those four models; each sum is at most two.
efficacy: two_hit beats observe by the one-sided exact sign test on failure-class seed scores.
Against current, two_hit credited pass count is no more than one lower on each failure-class model.
Against current, two_hit credited pass count is no more than two lower over the failure-class models combined.
nuisance_action_reduction: two_hit beats current by the one-sided exact sign test for fewer nuisance actions.
two_hit total nuisance actions are at most 60 percent of current over complete nuisance seed blocks.
funnel: Every process-valid two_hit seed has absolute tail-mass z <= 2.0.
At least half of process-valid two_hit seeds pass omega R-hat <= 1.01, omega bulk ESS >= 400, zero retained divergences, finite draws, and no sampler error: at least 5/10, 6/11, or 6/12.
two_hit full-funnel pass count is no more than one below either paired observe or current.
no_fire: At least 10 valid mesquite two_hit cells have zero restart actions.

Every valid zero-action current or two_hit cell on any target is bit-identical to observe in retained unconstrained and constrained draw bytes, total target calls, final step and metric hashes, and retained diagnostics; rescue telemetry is excepted.
efficiency: Every posteriordb model median paired two_hit/current efficiency ratio is at least 0.90.
The geometric mean over all valid posteriordb model/seed two_hit/current efficiency ratios is at least 0.95.

pre_evidence_conformance.failure_policy: Stop before evidence. A fix is allowed only before the first evidence cell and must be recorded.

red_lines.origin_overwritten: Any restart of an observe-defined stable separated origin.
red_lines.funnel: Any process-valid seed with absolute tail-mass z > 3.0, nonfinite retained draws, or sampler error.
red_lines.no_fire: Any zero-action cell not bit-identical to observe, or evidence that observe consumed rescue RNG or mutated state.

decision: If all completeness, safety, efficacy, nuisance-action reduction, funnel, no-fire, and efficiency gates pass, make two_hit the default.
Otherwise, if current has any origin_overwritten, reference, funnel, or no-fire red-line failure, make rescue disabled/no rescue the default.
An incomplete or inconclusive analysis makes two_hit fail but does not itself create a current red line.

predictions.P1: two_hit reduces nuisance actions by at least 40 percent and meets the exact sign gate.
predictions.P2: two_hit preserves current efficacy within the fixed count margins and beats observe on the failure-class exact sign test.
predictions.P3: observe identifies at least one stable separated hmm_drive_0 origin; current overwrites at least one; two_hit overwrites fewer but at least one.
predictions.P4: Neither mutating arm has a decisive reference disagreement; raw max |z| occasionally exceeds 4 only with practical shift below 0.10 reference SD.
predictions.P5: Every process-valid two_hit funnel seed has absolute tail-mass z <= 2, at least half pass the full funnel diagnostic gate, and two_hit is no more than one pass below either paired arm.
predictions.P6: At least 10 mesquite two_hit cells have no action and are bit-identical to observe.
predictions.P7: two_hit geometric-mean efficiency versus current is at least 0.95.
predictions.P8: The final decision is no rescue because two_hit is predicted to fail origin safety and current is predicted to have an origin_overwritten red line.

execution_rules: Report every planned cell and exclusion.
Report raw and credited diagnostics separately.
Do not tune, substitute targets or seeds, omit registered reference parameters, or pool across invalid triplets.
Do not rerun a child after observing any output.
An implementation bug found after the first evidence launch makes the study inconclusive and does not authorize restarting the evidence.
